name: Fairmont Dubai Hotel
positioning: Fairmont Dubai, a city hotel on Sheikh Zayed Road directly opposite Dubai World Trade Centre, with a rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers attending events at Dubai World Trade Centre
Guests who want a rooftop pool and city views in central Dubai

facts.text: Fairmont Dubai is located on Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai.
Rooms and suites have views of the Museum of the Future, Dubai Frame and Burj Khalifa.
The hotel has a sports bar called Trophy Room.
Afternoon tea is served at the Library Lounge.
The hotel has 14 restaurants and bars.
The Imperial 3 Bedroom Penthouse is a two-level penthouse with floor-to-ceiling windows.
Parking is included at the hotel.
The hotel has a spa offering treatments.

highlights.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool with views over the city.
The hotel is directly opposite Dubai World Trade Centre and within walking distance of the World Trade Centre Metro Station.
Theatrical dining is offered at The Theatre, Greek flavors at Opa and French cuisine at Bagatelle.
The Presidential 2 Bedroom Suite sits 34 storeys high and has a grand entrance hall, private dining and living areas and two bedrooms.
Café Sushi at the hotel serves sushi from a sushi belt.

considerations.text: The hotel is on Sheikh Zayed Road, opposite Dubai World Trade Centre, so it is a city-centre stay.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location that may not suit those seeking a quiet retreat.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury Dubai hotels.
